channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Terance Mann | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Terance Mann from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Terance Mann
item.description:
Tyronn Lue on Terance Mann's injury that will likely keep him out for the foreseeable future:

“It definitely impacts our team. ... The energy that T-Mann brings, since he's come off the bench he's been playing really well. ... It's not good timing.”

Tyronn Lue on Terance Mann, Dec 4, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Paul George on Terance Mann
item.description:
“I thought they made the big shots. I told T-Mann, if he doesn't make that 3, none of that would've happened to finish the game. I told Amir without that shot, we're walking away with an L.Those guys hit the biggest shots of the night.”

Paul George on Terance Mann, Apr 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Paul George on Terance Mann
item.description:
Paul George on Norm and T-Mann (two parts):

“Both of them did great for us. At this point, I think TMann is a little in his head about shooting the 3.I know he's not off to the best start percentage wise behind the line. The best way to get through that is to keep shooting.”

Paul George on Terance Mann, Dec 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Ty Lue on Terance Mann
item.description:
Ty Lue on Terance Mann trade rumors:

“We love T-Mann, and T-Mann is gonna be here. So we’re not worried about what they’re saying outside, all the speculations. It’s a good thing to be wanted.”

Ty Lue on Terance Mann, Oct 20, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Terance Mann
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Ty Lue on Terance Mann:

“He deserves it… playing the five and making seven 3’s in a close out game… he got better with each month. It goes to show you no matter if you go second round or undrafted, if you put the work in (you can succeed).”

Tyronn Lue on Terance Mann, Oct 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Paul George, Nicolas Batum, Kawhi Leonard, Marcus Morris, Luke Kennard, Terance Mann
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the Clippers:

“Because [Leonard and George are] such great players, there’s some tendency not to talk about other guys on their team— guys like Mann coming in, what Morris did today, Kennard, the defense that Batum played.”

Quin Snyder on Paul George, Nicolas Batum, Kawhi Leonard, Marcus Morris, Luke Kennard, Terance Mann, Jun 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Amir Coffey, Terance Mann
item.description:
Asked about the opportunity young Clippers could have because of several absences,Rivers said that

“Terance (Mann) has had a great week, Amir (Coffey) has been phenomenal.”

Doc Rivers on Amir Coffey, Terance Mann, Jul 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @AndrewGreif.
